patch_description: The original program just returned 14 random Gaussian points (score 0.02). Inspired by the idea of "construct then refine", I implement a fundamentally different approach: an invariant-normalized stochastic local search. Key insight: since the objective (dmin/dmax)^2 is scale-invariant, after every perturbation we rescale so the diameter equals 1, making the objective simply the minimum pairwise distance. The search alternates two targeted moves — pushing apart the closest pair and pulling together the farthest pair — under annealed Gaussian perturbations, with many seeded restarts including structured seeds (icosahedron-based and bi-layered configurations). The best configuration found is returned.
